name: Delivering Floral Gifts
description: This skill achieves prompt, damage-free delivery of delicate floral gifts across village locations without bumps or water spills. By carrying one order per trip using a pre-planned sequential route, florists maintain arrangement integrity and achieve full speed and placement accuracy in 7.4 to 7.5 seconds.

learned_parameters.label: Orders carried per trip
learned_parameters.rationale: A batch size of 1 order per trip was verified across attempts #1 through #10, consistently yielding a maximum score of 100.0 (Right place: 100, Speed: 100) and feedback 'Delivered in perfect shape!'. Transporting single arrangements protects delicate stems from physical impacts and spills. Measured: Capacity observed: 1.

control_effects.effect: Running the listed x1 plan delivered completion times of 7.5 s in attempt #1 and 7.4 s in attempts #2-#10, consistently producing a 100.0 overall score. Measured: Time and score per plan: listed x1: 7.5 s -> 100.0, listed x1: 7.4 s -> 100.0, listed x1: 7.4 s -> 100.0, listed x1: 7.4 s -> 100.0, listed x1: 7.4 s -> 100.0, listed x1: 7.4 s -> 100.0, listed x1: 7.4 s -> 100.0, listed x1: 7.4 s -> 100.0, listed x1: 7.4 s -> 100.0, listed x1: 7.4 s -> 100.0.

steps: Set dispatch handling batch size to 1 order per trip to avoid carrying overloaded arrangements that risk bumps, crushing, or water spills.
Adopt the 'listed' routing policy, following the sequential delivery queue order: order-1, order-2, order-3, and order-4.
Pick up order-1 from the flower cart counter and courier it directly to spot:st-jude-village.
Return to the counter, collect order-2, and transport it safely to spot:the-old-mill-bridal.
Pick up order-3 and deliver it without sudden tilt or drops to spot:the-riverside-bakery.
Collect the final order-4 and deliver it directly to spot:meadowview-memorial, completing the full four-stop cycle in approximately 7.4 to 7.5 seconds.
caveats: Never bundle multiple floral arrangements into a single trip; carrying more than 1 order at a time risks physical collisions and spills.
Ensure each specific order is matched exactly to its designated location drop-off to avoid penalties on the Right Place sub-score.
Maintain consistent transit pacing along direct path lines to complete all drops within the optimal 7.4-7.5 second window.
